meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 项目添加 Google Chat 通道支持:自动从 channels 分支复制适配器代码、注册到模块入口、安装指定版本依赖,并构建和跑测试验证。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Google Chat 通道,或要求配置 Google Chat 集成时触发。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat 通道
say.note: 自动完成代码复制、注册、装依赖和测试。

say.text: 配置 Google Chat 集成,并检查凭证
say.note: 会提示你粘贴服务账号 JSON 到 .env。

howto.what_en: Adds Google Chat channel support to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, then builds and runs tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Google Chat channel or set up the integration.

say_en.note: Copies, registers, installs, and tests automatically.

say_en.text: Configure the integration and check credentials
say_en.note: Prompts you to paste the service account JSON into .env.
